whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Level Up Gaming Lounge & Café,

I noticed your gaming lounge has strong 4.3★ reviews in Danapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new customer tournament sign-ups and cafe reservations.

Maine aapke gaming lounge ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table/PC booking, gaming packages, aur café menu integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/levelup

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Level Up Gaming Lounge, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, direct WhatsApp PC/table booking, and your café menu showcase in Gola Road, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact pricing, real setup photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
